tools.name: Transform Text
tools.description: Switch text between UPPER, lower, Title, camelCase, snake_case and more

tools.name: Clipboard History
tools.description: Keep recent copied text and images and paste any of them again
tools.note: Opt-in monitoring. History is kept in memory; review clipboard privacy limits before enabling it.

tools.name: Unit Converter
tools.description: Convert length, mass, temperature, data size and time

tools.name: Break Time
tools.description: Get gentle reminders to step away from the screen
tools.note: Notifications require permission. Full-screen activity detection is best effort.

tools.name: Timer & Stopwatch
tools.description: Count down to zero or measure elapsed time with laps

tools.name: World Time
tools.description: See the current time in cities around the world

tools.name: Verify Checksum
tools.description: Hash a file with SHA-256, SHA-1, MD5 or BLAKE3 and compare it

tools.name: Find Duplicates
tools.description: Find identical files, even with different names, and free up space

tools.name: Archive & Unarchive
tools.description: Compress files to zip or tar.gz and extract zip, tar and 7z

tools.name: Clean Drive
tools.description: Find temporary and cache files and move what you choose to the trash

tools.name: Screenshot
tools.description: Capture the whole screen, a window or an area to file and clipboard
tools.note: Capture permissions and desktop-session restrictions apply, especially on Wayland.

tools.name: Resize Images
tools.description: Resize one or many images and convert between formats

tools.name: QR & Barcode
tools.description: Turn text or a link into a QR code or barcode image

tools.name: System Monitor
tools.description: Watch CPU, memory, disk and the busiest processes in one view

tools.name: Network Usage
tools.description: See live upload and download speed and totals

tools.name: Do Not Sleep
tools.description: Keep the computer and display awake for as long as you need

tools.name: Sleep Timer
tools.description: Put the computer to sleep or shut it down after a countdown
tools.note: Explicit confirmation before arming a power action. Cancel from the launcher banner.

tools.name: Lock Screen
tools.description: Lock the computer instantly
tools.note: macOS uses display sleep; immediate password protection depends on your OS settings.

tools.name: Hide Desktop
tools.description: Hide desktop icons for presentations and screen sharing
tools.note: Changes desktop icon visibility. Linux is not supported.

tools.name: Encrypt Files
tools.description: Protect files with a passphrase using modern age encryption

tools.name: Mouse Activity
tools.description: Gently move the pointer while idle and automatically yield when you return
tools.note: Windows only. Starts only when you choose, moves the pointer while idle, and yields when input resumes. Stop from the app or tray.

tools.name: Window on Top
tools.description: Keep a chosen window above other windows
tools.note: Windows native window controls; some protected applications may refuse changes.

tools.name: Window Manager
tools.description: Place windows in halves, thirds or quarters of a display
tools.note: Windows native window controls; minimum window sizes can constrain layouts.

tools.name: Show Desktop
tools.description: Minimize application windows to reveal the desktop
tools.note: Windows only. Restores the windows tracked by this session.

tools.name: Close Apps
tools.description: Review open windows and request that selected apps close
tools.note: Requests normal window closure after review. Applications may show their own save prompts.

tools.name: Focus on Window
tools.description: Dim the space around a chosen window
tools.note: Windows dimming overlays; multi-monitor runtime acceptance is still open.

tools.name: Switch Resolution
tools.description: Try a display mode with an automatic rollback countdown
tools.note: Windows only. A confirmation countdown automatically requests rollback if you do not keep the mode.

tools.name: Eject Volumes
tools.description: Review removable volumes and request a safe eject
tools.note: Windows only. Busy or protected devices can refuse an eject request.

tools.name: Energy Saver
tools.description: Choose an available operating-system power plan
tools.note: Selects an available Windows power plan; available plans depend on the device.

tools.name: Hidden Files
tools.description: Show or hide hidden files in the system file manager
tools.note: Uses file-manager settings on Windows and macOS; changing macOS settings can restart Finder.

tools.name: CPU Temperature
tools.description: Read temperature sensors exposed by the operating system
tools.note: Only sensors exposed by the system are available. Many Windows devices expose none.

tools.name: Launch App Sets
tools.description: Save and open a reviewed group of local apps or files

tools.name: Uninstall Apps
tools.description: Review registered uninstallers and separately inspect leftovers
tools.note: Windows registered uninstallers. Leftover inspection is separate from uninstalling.

tools.name: Presentation Mode
tools.description: Coordinate keep-awake and desktop visibility for a presentation
tools.note: Combines keep-awake with supported desktop controls. Notification settings remain manual OS controls.

tools.name: Do Not Disturb
tools.description: Open the supported system controls for notification interruptions
tools.note: Opens supported OS settings. You change the notification mode yourself.

tools.name: Airplane Mode
tools.description: Open Windows controls for wireless radios and airplane mode
tools.note: Opens Windows airplane-mode settings. You control the radios in Windows.

tools.name: Alarm
tools.description: Schedule local reminders with time-zone and recurrence controls
tools.note: Requires notification permission and Oxbox to remain running; the app does not wake a powered-off computer.

tools.name: Date Countdown
tools.description: Count down to dated events in explicit time zones
tools.note: Uses explicit time zones. Notifications require permission and a running app.

tools.name: Mute Microphone
tools.description: Inspect and toggle the default input-device mute state
tools.note: Windows default input device; Linux requires a working pactl/PulseAudio-compatible server.

tools.name: Record Audio
tools.description: Record an explicitly selected audio input to a new local file
tools.note: Requires your own FFmpeg installation, a supported input device, and OS permission.

tools.name: Record Screen
tools.description: Record a screen, area or window with explicit start and stop
tools.note: Requires FFmpeg. Linux recording currently uses X11; macOS and Wayland recording are unavailable through this provider.

tools.name: Make GIF
tools.description: Create a local animated GIF from a video segment
tools.note: Requires your own FFmpeg installation. Converts a selected local video segment.

tools.name: Convert Audio / Video
tools.description: Convert local media with reviewed offline format presets
tools.note: Requires your own FFmpeg installation. Available codecs depend on that build.

tools.name: Take Photo
tools.description: Capture a photo from an explicitly selected camera
tools.note: Requires FFmpeg, a supported camera and OS camera permission.

tools.name: Take Video
tools.description: Record a selected camera with visible controls and a duration limit
tools.note: Requires FFmpeg and camera permission. Camera recording does not include microphone audio.

tools.name: Recognize Text
tools.description: Extract text from a local image using an available offline OCR engine
tools.note: Windows OCR uses installed language packs. Other platforms require user-installed Tesseract and language data.

tools.name: Barcode Reader
tools.description: Read QR codes and supported barcodes from a local image

tools.name: Measure Color
tools.description: Sample an image or screen pixel as HEX, RGB, HSL and CMYK
tools.note: Local-image sampling works without screen permission; screen sampling inherits capture restrictions.

tools.name: Currency Converter
tools.description: Convert dated reference rates with offline import and opt-in ECB refresh
tools.note: Import dated reference rates locally, or explicitly opt into a manual ECB HTTPS refresh. Reference rates are not live trading quotes.
